items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Benny Moten in the context of other bands and musicians (Basie, Dee Stewart, Claude Williams) but does not state any personal interaction, employment, or direct collaboration with Moten himself.

ctx.x: What sort of group did Bus Moten have then? Benny Moten had died, hadn't he?

Yeah, Benny Moten died, and see, these guys were trying to get that Reno club after Basie left, see. By this time Basie had gone to New York, you know. In fact, he'd been gone for some time. But anyway, it was in '36 or '37.
